PLATFORM-00B is the only active increment. It implements shared process identity and per-profile single-instance lease semantics above platform-specific process probes; it is not an OS launcher or package implementation.
Process identity is canonical platform/architecture + PID + hashed opaque process-start token. PID alone is never ownership identity and raw OS labels/cwd/process path are not part of identity.
A foreign ALIVE lease cannot be stolen. UNKNOWN liveness is fail-closed as UNCERTAIN. Only verified DEAD ownership may be archived and replaced.
Takeover re-reads and re-probes the exact current owner before replacement. If a first DEAD result becomes ALIVE or UNKNOWN, replacement is cancelled.

Takeover markers are process-bound recovery state. The same exact process can resume an interrupted takeover before or after stale archival; a foreign live/unknown marker remains fail-closed; a verified-dead marker may be cleared so it cannot block the profile forever.
Stale lease replacement archives the exact previous lease and returns it in REPLACED_STALE rather than pretending the prior owner never existed.
Release requires the exact current process fingerprint and lease nonce. Malformed/tampered/symlink state fails visibly.
